definitions.explanation: A race where participants run a set distance on foot, typically a short dash. Most commonly refers to the running events at school sports days in Japan.

examples.japanese: {運動会|うんどうかい}の{徒競走|ときょうそう}で{一位|いちい}になった。
examples.english: I came first in the footrace at the sports day.

examples.japanese: {徒競走|ときょうそう}は{五十|ごじゅう}メートルです。
{小学校|しょうがっこう}の{運動会|うんどうかい}で{徒競走|ときょうそう}に{出|で}るのが{楽|たの}しみだった。
examples.english: I looked forward to running in the footrace at the elementary school sports day.

notes:
FORMS:
{徒|と} (on foot) + {競走|きょうそう} (race). Literally 'a race on foot.'

CULTURAL NOTE:
A staple event at Japanese school {運動会|うんどうかい} (sports days). Students typically run short distances (50m–100m depending on age). It is one of the most memorable events of school life for many Japanese people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運動会|うんどうかい}の{徒競走|ときょうそう} (sports day footrace)
- {徒競走|ときょうそう}で{走|はし}る (to run in a footrace)
- {徒競走|ときょうそう}で{一位|いちい} (first place in a footrace)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {競走|きょうそう}: race — broader term that includes any kind of racing
- かけっこ: running race — informal, childish word for the same thing
